    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    BonusTotem.activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    When the owner ends their turn (Trigger.END_TURN), marks the bonus food tile flag so the totem-placement bonus is applied by ActionExecutionState.
    void
    CharMultiplier.activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    At end-game (Trigger.END_GAME), grants the owner multiplier prestige points for each card of type typeMul in their hand.
    void
    EndGame.activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    At end-game (Trigger.END_GAME), applies the configured BuildingEffect: doubles building PP via BuildingBonus, grants 6 PP per card in the owner's smallest non-building card-type group, or grants a flat 25 PP.
    void
    ExtraMove.activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    At the end of the round (Trigger.END_ROUND), marks the extra-move flag so the owner gets an additional card draw from the upper row, handled by ExtraMoveState.
    void
    SinceBuilt.activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    When the owner draws a card (Trigger.DRAWING), records the last drawn character in characterInUse and checks the configured BuildingEffect: FOOD_COMPLETE_SET – if the owner now has at least one card of every character type, grants 5 food and removes one card from each type's tracked set (resetting the "set" progress). COUPLE_INVENTOR – if two tracked Inventors share the same icon, grants 3 food and removes that pair from tracking.

  • Uses of Player in org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.forEvent

    Method parameters in org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.forEvent with type arguments of type Player
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    DuringEvent.activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    Forwards to DuringEvent.execute(Set, Trigger) only if t is one of the four event triggers; ignores all other triggers (e.g. building-placement triggers).
    abstract void
    DuringEvent.execute(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    Applies the building's event-specific bonus.
    void
    DuringHunt.execute(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    Sets the owner's huntEventBonus flag when the trigger is Trigger.HUNT, so Hunt.activeEffect() grants the extra +1 food/+1 PP per Hunter.
    void
    DuringPaintings.execute(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    Sets the owner's artistFood flag when the trigger is Trigger.CAVE_PAINTINGS, so CavePaintings.activeEffect() grants +1 food per Artist card owned.
    void
    DuringRitual.execute(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    Applies this building's BuildingEffect to the owner's BuildingBonus when the trigger is Trigger.SHAMANIC_RITUAL: grants ritual PP-loss immunity, +3 virtual shaman stars, or doubles PP gained if the owner wins the ritual alone, depending on buildingEffect.
    void
    DuringSustenance.execute(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
    Sets the owner's Sustenance food discount, when the trigger is Trigger.SUSTENANCE, to the number of cards the owner has of type typeMultiplier.
